## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written before implementation (RED/GREEN visible in commit order)
- [ ] All new public API has Doxygen comments including ordering guarantees
- [ ] `clang-format` clean
- [ ] `clang-tidy` clean (at the configured level)
- [ ] No new compiler warnings on any matrix entry
- [ ] Invariant IDs touched listed in commit footer: `Invariants: I3, I9`
- [ ] `Wire-format: unchanged` or `Wire-format: changed — wire-format.md updated` in footer
- [ ] If a design decision was made: an ADR exists under `docs/src/adr/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] CI green on the full required set
